extractions.description: This paper introduces Multi-Objective GFlowNets (MOGFNs) for generating diverse Pareto optimal solutions in the context of Multi-Objective Optimization (MOO). The method leverages GFlowNets to generate candidates that optimize conflicting objectives, particularly in applications such as drug discovery and material design. The paper proposes two variants, MOGFN-PC and MOGFN-AL, to explore different decomposition strategies in MOO and demonstrates the benefits in terms of Pareto performance and candidate diversity.

While applications like drug discovery and material design may indirectly relate, the paper does not emphasize a direct link to sustainability.

In many applications of machine learning such as drug discovery and material design, the goal is to generate candidates which simultaneously optimize a set of potentially conflicting objectives.
